<div class="row">

```{r echo=FALSE}
#### Load API functions ####
source("R/github_api_conv.R")

#### Use GitHub Actions token if available ####
oauth <- Sys.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", unset = "")

#### Get repositories from GitHub API ####
repo_info <- if (nzchar(oauth)) {
  api_call(
    "https://api.github.com/orgs/ISAAKiel/repos?per_page=100",
    "name",
    oauth
  )
} else {
  api_call(
    "https://api.github.com/orgs/ISAAKiel/repos?per_page=100",
    "name"
  )
}
```

```{r results = 'asis', echo = FALSE}
#### textoutput ####
for (i in 1:nrow(repo_info)){
  cat('<div class="col-xs-6 col-sm-3">')
  cat('<div class="card">')
  cat('<div class="card-content"><h4 class="card-title">')
  title_string <- repo_info$name[i]
  cat('<a href="',repo_info$html_url[i],'" style="color:#345578;">',title_string, "</a></h4><br/>")
  cat('<div class="">')
  cat(repo_info$description[i])
  cat('</div>')
  cat('</div>')
  cat('</div>')
  cat('</div>')
}
```

</div>
